evaluation.feature_cutoff: Existing fixed market quote observed_at, strictly before source/official scheduled starts and known actual firstPitch. Same information cutoff as market reference.

fixed_home_control.probability_reference: 0.5 fixed uninformative reference, not certainty of home win.

evaluation.probability_scoring: Same admitted games for candidate, market and fixed-home 0.5 reference; exclude no model probabilities.
evaluation.quote_freshness: Descriptive only; no live decision timestamp or execution-quality claim. Existing live risk policy untouched.
evaluation.snapshot_rule: Reuse exact prior eligible-game snapshot and raw-record hash; no replacement after candidate outcomes, no closing-price substitution. Require unique full identity and both prices.

feature_definition.completeness: Full season-to-cutoff team history required; a sampled subset is insufficient.
feature_definition.history: All completed regular-season games in the current season strictly before feature cutoff. Season reset; no sliding-window search.
feature_definition.home_advantage: Unpenalized intercept; no duplicate constant feature.
feature_definition.missing_or_unknown_completion: Reject target; no derived clock, date-only imputation, latest-season record or silent missing-history skip.
feature_definition.suspended_resumed_games: Exclude target if a potentially relevant season-to-date history has unresolved final completion chronology; never count suspended physical game twice.

gate: If actual completion chronology, full training feature coverage or paired pregame market evidence is missing, stop without any fit, probability prediction, metrics evaluation or bulk acquisition.
hypothesis: Completed-game run magnitudes may add information beyond wins/losses; unproven.

skill_review.application: No listed local skill applies to this narrow offline MLB data gate: WBC betting, EOS document generation and exhaustive source-tree QA are outside scope. None invoked.
skill_review.visible_context: Prior state is complete in this thread; personal-context trigger review requires no extra retrieval.

training.label: Home final runs > away final runs, independently verified against recorded home_win; ties/missing/conflicts excluded.
training.label_cutoff: Training labels must be settled before the earliest evaluation quote.
training.solver: Deterministic 3-parameter damped Newton, max_iter=100, max backtracking=20, absolute gradient infinity-norm tolerance=1e-8; fail rather than fall back/tune.
training.split: Full earlier 2025 regular season, warmup/strict-input admitted rows only. 2024 audited as earlier alternative, never reverse split after seeing candidate metrics.
training.standardization: Training-only mean and population standard deviation for each feature; zero SD uses scale=1.
